messages:
incident-bot: P1 detected  High tail latency for hosted text-generation in eu-west-1. 99th percentile token latency ~1.3s. PagerDuty ticket PD-4491. War room: https://meet.redwood.internal/room/PD-4491 (auto-created)
Maya Patel: I'm taking incident owner. Jumping into the war room now.
Samir Khan: On-call here. I'm running initial health checks on the GPU node fleet and controller logs.
Leo Park: Captured traces for 06:22-06:28 UTC. There's a clear spike of GPU driver restarts and device-plugin registration failures in that window. Posting log excerpt.
Rae Chen: Customer reports: multiple tenants seeing request timeouts and streaming interruptions. ETA for external comms? We should acknowledge and say we're investigating.
Maya Patel: Draft status page blurb: "Investigating elevated generation latency in eu-west-1. Some requests may time out or be slower. Engineers are actively investigating. We'll post updates every 30 minutes." Good?
Leo Park: Add that we're routing a fraction of traffic to eu-west-2 as a targeted mitigation and we've scaled warm capacity there.
Samir Khan: Initial findings: new pods created by HPA remained Pending/CrashLoop due to device plugin not binding after node reboots. Suspect a kernel update rolled through the zone earlier.
Leo Park: Log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T06:23:11Z device-plugin: WARN: plugin registration failed: NVML_ERROR_DRIVER_NOT_LOADED
2026-03-15T06:23:14Z kubelet: ERR: device plugin connection lost: transport is closing
```
Maya Patel: Immediate action items: 1) Samir to cordon/drain affected nodes and reprovision if needed, 2) Scale warm pool in eu-west-2 and shift 15% traffic as a canary, 3) Rae to prepare customer-facing note, 4) Leo to continue trace collection.
Samir Khan: Running commands now:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-12
kubectl drain gpu-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
redwoodctl pool scale --region eu-west-2 --pool warm --replicas 14
redwoodctl routing set --region eu-west-2 --percentage 15 --reason "canary fallback"
```
Rae Chen: Customer message draft: "We're investigating higher-than-normal latency in eu-west-1 affecting text generation. We've temporarily routed part of traffic to an alternate region and are monitoring performance. We will provide updates in 30 minutes. For urgent issues, contact support@redwood.ai."
Maya Patel: Short and clear. Post to status page and send to affected customers list. Keep tone factual; no speculation.
pagerduty-bot: Pager acknowledged by Samir Khan at 06:25 UTC.
Samir Khan: Cordon/drain completed for 3 nodes. Warm pool in eu-west-2 scaled. Routing change in effect. Observing queued tasks draining into warm pool.
Leo Park: Canary traffic shows latency improvements: P95 for routed requests ~420ms after ~3 minutes. Remaining eu-west-1 traffic still elevated.
Maya Patel: Rae, please publish status page now and fire customer notifications to the list of tenants who've opened support tickets. Include support@redwood.ai contact.
Rae Chen: Status posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/PD-4491. Customer email queued and sent to priority tenants. Template used and pasted here for record.
Rae Chen: Customer email: "Hi <Customer>, we are currently investigating increased inference latency in eu-west-1 impacting text-generation. We have routed a portion of traffic to an alternative region and are monitoring. We will follow up with updates every 30 minutes. Reach support@redwood.ai for immediate assistance."
Maya Patel: Tracking affected customers internally: please add any incoming support tickets to the incident doc with priority flag. Leo, can you list who reported so far?
Leo Park: Current list: BeaconHealth (reported timeouts, prioritized and routed), Shoplane (reported streaming stalls, investigating), QuantifyAI (no report yet but flagged).
Samir Khan: Next infra step: if device-plugin doesn't auto-recover, we will reprovision nodes from image-2026-02-12 which has validated driver stack. Raising rollback plan with infra.
incident-bot: Incident remains P1. Incident wiki created: https://wiki.redwood.internal/incidents/PD-4491
Maya Patel: Post-kickoff plan: 1) Maintain cross-region routing until eu-west-1 nodes healthy or P95 < 600ms, 2) schedule kernel-rollback if necessary, 3) collect artifacts for postmortem. Assign postmortem leads: Maya + Leo.
Samir Khan: Note: I will need a handoff in ~35 minutes. I'll post a handoff update here before leaving.
Rae Chen: I'll prepare the 30-minute status update with current metrics and ETA.
Maya Patel: Thanks all. War room open. If anyone is stepping away, reply to this thread before handing off pager. End of kickoff. :white_check_mark:
